in_hebrew.name: שִמוֹנִית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'שָמַע' (shama), which means 'to hear'. The name Simon is derived from this root, and the feminine form is Simone or Simonette.

in_greek.name: Σιμωνηττα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Σιμων' (Simon), which means 'he who hears'. The feminine form is likely 'Simonetta' or 'Simonette'.

in_latin.name: Simonetta
in_latin.long_meaning: Translated from the Greek name 'Σιμωνηττα' (Simonetta), which means 'Little Simon'. The name is derived from the Latin name 'Simon'.
